newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas softer as July and August trade down.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas softer as July and August trade down.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures weakened in thin trade on Friday afternoon, as two deals were done on top of the two done in the morning session.
July and August each traded 25 lots at the same time on Friday afternoon and at the same price, 9.50 pence a therm.
The price represented a fall from Thursday's settlement price of 0.30 pence in July and 0.33 pence in August.

The two deals brought the total volume of trade for the day to 95 lots. By the close, bids and offers were posted for July, August and September, with offers well below the previous settlement level in each case. But no offers were posted after September.
